unit: paired independent labels for one benchmark example
overall_exact_agreement: (both YES + both NO) / all paired examples
yes_agreement: 2 * both YES / (2 * both YES + split YES/NO)
no_agreement: 2 * both NO / (2 * both NO + split YES/NO)
field_presence_agreement: among examples where both say YES, proportion where both field values are null or both non-null
field_literal_agreement: among examples where both say YES and both fields are non-null, proportion with equal lowercase whitespace-normalized strings
interpretation: The class minimum is a predeclared coverage guardrail, not an accuracy measure. No outcome labels or predictive metrics are used.
